headline: Argentina Beef Export Revenues Reach Record $4.32 Billion Through October
summary: Argentina generated $4.316 billion from beef exports between January and October, representing a 36.4% value increase compared to the same period in 2025 due to elevated international prices.
why: Beef is one of Argentina's primary agricultural export commodities and a critical source of foreign currency reserves.

impacts.why: Beef export revenues rose 36.4% year-to-date to reach a record $4.32 billion.
